status: proposed sequencing; no calendar promise or implicit approval

phases.name: Inventory and scope
phases.deliverables: Saved source IDs,34place matrix,16kit catalog, exclusions and current budget; distinguish references, models and runtime.
phases.exit_evidence: This plan provides the initial audit; source facts are preserved.

phases.name: Geography and route blockout
phases.deliverables: Elevation/shore/water layers, site pads, crossing locations, regional transitions and travel graph.
phases.exit_evidence: All G01–G08 decisions resolved enough for first routes; concept polylines are not marked playable.
phases.evidence: blockout/WEST-CONNECTION.md; west-verification.json and west-browser-verification.json. Matched-arrival stair/ramp alternatives, existing FC05 loop and proposed B12 gate connected; complete stair route return tested. Internal village streets, support engineering and remaining regional conflicts unresolved.

phases.name: Shared kit and technical contracts
phases.deliverables: Units, pivots, seam profiles, opening standards, glass/material IDs, UV scale, collision, LOD/instancing and loading groups.
phases.exit_evidence: One floor/wall/opening/rail/path/water-edge example physically fits and survives actual player/camera tests.
phases.evidence: village-fit/README.md; fitting-review.json; details-verification.json and details-browser-verification.json. 32 procedural fit specimens cover 11 saved B12 detail types, with an isolated hollow chimney pot pending shaft/flue. Door, shutter pivots, mounting faces, complete return routes and rendering-only cutaways tested. Final carving, art/Form acceptance and roof weather joins unresolved. Roof follow-up: village-fit/roof-fit/README.md; real shaft/roof apertures, framing contacts, valley wall/scupper clearance, downpipe/sump bore and browser inspection. Onward site drain, rain management and final structure remain unresolved.

phases.name: Two playable samples
phases.deliverables: B01bedroom/balcony and F02one cottage/clearing/pond-edge loop; human furniture and one reusable interaction test.
phases.exit_evidence: Both load in real browser with correct collision, route, openings, return and measured performance. Reference approval before paid generation; no paid work is authorised by this planning document.
phases.evidence: village-fit/ROOM.md, room-review.json, room-verification.json and details-browser-verification.json. Village sitting-room specimen uses six saved cottage designs, proposed table/lamp fixtures, corrected 2.45 m ceiling, proximity chime and four complete route returns. B12 is distinct from FC05/F02 and B01; no complete-location or final-art approval is implied.

phases.name: Regional route production
phases.deliverables: Execute W2–W6; for each place terrain/arrival first, structure second, selected interior/circulation third, ecology/decor fourth, behavior/effects last.
phases.exit_evidence: Complete the stated D2/D3/D4coverage; every place has evidence rather than a saved image count.

phases.name: World integration
phases.deliverables: Connect routes, palace spine, bridges, land/sea/sky arrivals, state persistence and streaming transitions.
phases.exit_evidence: No orphan destination, underwater landing, inaccessible entrance, broken return or forced huge empty walk.

phases.name: Polish and performance
phases.deliverables: Refine repeated materials/joins, foliage density, wildlife behavior, shadows, weather/waves and light/ambience.
phases.exit_evidence: Review final production camera and device measurements; runtime/deployment approval is separate from reference archive publication.

regional_waves.name: Two playable samples
regional_waves.dependencies: Shared player/camera/collision conventions, material scale and provisional geography
regional_waves.exit_evidence: One bedroom-to-balcony route and one forest-cottage route loaded in the real browser; reference images alone cannot pass.

regional_waves.name: Royal grounds and west woodland loop
regional_waves.dependencies: W1 validated plus path/water/vegetation starter kits
regional_waves.exit_evidence: Village, palace garden edge, lake and woodland destinations connected; no long empty mandatory walks.

regional_waves.name: Lake, lagoon, harbour and open coast
regional_waves.dependencies: Water levels, shoreline, bridge/jetty interfaces and measured glass/water budget plus a shared step/landing and vertical-access prototype
regional_waves.exit_evidence: Dry routes, landings, selected interiors and tidal viewpoints usable; ocean visuals remain distinct from calm lake water.

regional_waves.name: Misty forest and local highlands
regional_waves.dependencies: W1 terrain conventions, W2 forest base and working vertical-route prototype
regional_waves.exit_evidence: Ridge/forest loops and selected upper decks have safe physical access or clearly specified travel; local timber/stone styles retained.

regional_waves.name: Jungle and canyon landmarks
regional_waves.dependencies: W3 wet/dry edge tests and W4 slopes/vertical circulation
regional_waves.exit_evidence: Dense jungle and dry canyon each have a readable, performant route and source-specific landmark kit.

regional_waves.name: Sky destinations
regional_waves.dependencies: Tested arrival/return travel, containment, streaming and fall/reset behavior
regional_waves.exit_evidence: Each island has a working arrival and return, explorable focal route and bounded content; no flight system is assumed.

current_next_deliverable: Furnish, light and test the accepted palace bedroom/west-balcony sample, retaining room and balcony dimensions and human-scale furnishings. FC05 now has a separate tested cottage/clearing Function fixture; exact cottage sleeping furniture, final vegetation art, roof/weather details and integration remain pending.
local_first_rule: Resolve world geography at coarse level, but only require sample-local elevations, water, boundaries and access for the first prototype; refine distant-region unknowns in their own wave.
